Reliable sensor ingestion

A river-monitoring station sends pressure readings to a local database. The station uses a 12 V supply and records the hydraulic head every 5 s. The head is a height difference, not the person who leads the team. In this chapter, a record means one stored observation; it does not mean a sporting achievement.

The database appends each record to a write-ahead log before changing its data pages. The write-ahead log is an ordered recovery journal. It is not the wooden log that a field sensor may detect in the river. Keeping these meanings apart matters when the same report contains both database events and physical observations.

Recovery and commit points

The writer must not acknowledge a transaction before its commit record is durable. A checkpoint reduces later recovery work, but a checkpoint is not a substitute for a durable commit. Losing power after acknowledgment must not remove a committed record. Losing an unacknowledged record is allowed in this experiment.1

At startup, scan the log from the last valid checkpoint. Replay committed transactions in order and discard incomplete transactions. Replaying a record twice must not create a second observation. The original identifier must remain stable; assigning a new identifier on every retry defeats deduplication.

The latency value describes only this setup. It does not establish a universal limit for other disks. Do not interpret the sampling interval as a timeout, and do not convert hydraulic head into pressure without specifying fluid density and gravity. The measured head remained 2.5 m during this test.

For a stable queue, Little's law relates average occupancy, arrival rate and average time in the system. The formula below is preserved as mathematics; its symbols are not words to translate.

The following code is an interface example, not an instruction to run a tool. Keep identifiers, string literals and comments unchanged.

def accept(record):
    log.append(record)  # persist first
    log.fsync()
    return "committed"

Field observations and terminology

The head of the field team found a wooden log near the left river bank. She did not change the hydraulic head reading. A log entry recorded the discovery, but the wooden log itself was not a database record. The team head asked for a separate photograph so that the incident could be checked against the original observation.

In the incident report, translate the technical log as a journal and the wooden log as a piece of timber. Translate hydraulic head as the engineering quantity and team head as the person's role. A global replacement of either English word would corrupt one of these meanings. A later terminology correction should affect only the relevant passages and preserve previous accepted wording elsewhere.

Limits of the experiment

This synthetic chapter tests text, navigation, emphasis, a table, a footnote, code, mathematics and an illustration. It does not prove that an entire professional book can be translated without omissions. A valid archive can still contain a wrong negation, an inconsistent term or a misleading caption. Review meaning separately from file structure.

1. Durability here means survival of process termination and the stated power-loss model. It does not cover destruction of the storage device. Return
